extension.description: Reviews Kranz action execution, runtime lifecycle changes, configuration replacement, and retained evidence deletion.
extension.name: Kranz command protection

permissions.label: Kranz action execution
permissions.description: Runs a configured action, including commands with typed parameters and plan-bound CLI confirmation.
safer_guidance: Inspect the action with `kranz actions info OWNER/ACTION` and review its parameters before running it.

permissions.label: Kranz runtime creation
permissions.description: Creates a runtime and can start selected or all enabled services.
safer_guidance: Inspect `kranz plan SELECTOR ...` and the chosen runtime configuration before starting services.

permissions.label: Kranz service start
permissions.description: Starts selected services and their dependencies in an existing runtime.
safer_guidance: Review `kranz plan SELECTOR ...` before starting services.

permissions.label: Kranz service stop
permissions.description: Stops selected services and may affect dependent services.
safer_guidance: Review `kranz plan --operation stop SELECTOR ...` and attached clients before stopping services.

permissions.label: Kranz service restart
permissions.description: Restarts selected services and may affect dependent services.
safer_guidance: Review `kranz plan --operation restart SELECTOR ...` before restarting services.

permissions.label: Kranz runtime reload
permissions.description: Applies changed configuration to the running runtime and can update, start, or stop services.
safer_guidance: Review the effective configuration and affected services before reloading.

permissions.label: Kranz runtime shutdown
permissions.description: Stops the whole project runtime and removes its retained in-memory state; --force recovers an unresponsive runtime.
safer_guidance: Inspect `kranz status` and `kranz clients` before shutting down the runtime.

permissions.label: Kranz log buffer deletion
permissions.description: Discards retained log output for a target, or for every stream when --force is supplied.
safer_guidance: Export or inspect needed output with `kranz logs TARGET` before clearing it.

permissions.label: Kranz retained run deletion
permissions.description: Permanently deletes a completed run and its buffered output after explicit CLI confirmation.
safer_guidance: Inspect the target with `kranz runs TARGET` before deleting the retained run.

permissions.label: Kranz configuration replacement
permissions.description: Allows non-interactive replacement of an existing Kranz configuration file.
safer_guidance: Review the destination file and the proposed configuration before replacing it.
